campaign.title: Attack the balanced endpoint with the actual fixed profiles

conductor_policy.monitoring: Conductor checks exact profile normalization, both frequency signs, endpoint constants, stationary errors, character retention, and proves-too-much controls.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close with a proved endpoint edge, a rigorously smaller endpoint subregion, or an exact obstruction plus the weakest surviving signed lemma.

numerical_purpose: falsify a precise endpoint cancellation claim
identify an exact arithmetic transition for proof
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Finite endpoint samples cannot promote an asymptotic estimate.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only for endpoint reciprocal sums, bilinear square-root sums, or large-sieve inputs.

frozen_target.endpoint: D asymp X^(1/2), 1<=L<=X^(1/4), excluding the already solved L=1 and L asymp X^(1/4) endpoints.
frozen_target.original_target: |B_L(D;X)|<<X^(1/4+epsilon) for the actual fixed normalized-BV denominator profile.
frozen_target.sine_kernel: B_L=4 sum_d w_D(d)chi_4(r_d) sum_(h>0 odd) a_h sin(pi h(X-dr_d)/(2d)).
frozen_target.dual_target: At D=X^(1/2), K=XL/D^2 asymp L and M=LK asymp L^2; prove T_(L,L)<<L^(3/2)X^epsilon for the actual chi_4(h) symbol.
forbidden_conflations: arbitrary bounded weights with the prescribed fixed profile
positive frequencies with the full two-sided sine kernel
unweighted square-root sums with localized divisor coefficients
a Cauchy mean square with the weaker signed target
perfect-square model X with uniform real X

tasks.target: Write an explicit smooth dyadic partition and endpoint truncation or merging rule for the actual d-sum. Prove uniform discrete BV for every block, sampled l1 nondegeneracy wherever W-1 is invoked, and compatibility with smooth Poisson. State exactly which existing conditional results become unconditional for this chosen decomposition.

Attack the full endpoint interval through the exact two-sided sine kernel for one prescribed fixed smooth profile. Use the nearest-odd product geometry, quadratic endpoint expansion, or exact summation. Either prove X^(1/4+epsilon) on a nontrivial L-range or construct a fixed-profile coherent obstruction. Check X=4N^2 only as a hostile model and then return to uniform real X.

At K asymp L, attack T=sum_(h,k asymp L) chi_4(h)a(h,k)e(sqrt(Xhk)) at the L^(3/2) target. Preserve chi_4 before Cauchy, analyze product multiplicities and square-root spacing, and audit any primary theorem exactly. Prove a nontrivial L-range, derive a sharp obstruction, or isolate a strictly weaker signed lemma than the character-erasing mean square.

completion_criteria: The actual dyadic and endpoint profile norms are explicit.
The balanced endpoint is attacked independently in original and dual coordinates.
Every claimed saving retains the actual character or states where it is lost.
Special square X and general real X are not conflated.
No global M2 promotion occurs unless every endpoint L-block is covered.
campaign.promotion_policy: Round 6 may promote explicit profile infrastructure, scoped endpoint ranges, exact endpoint identities, or no-go obstructions. It may promote endpoint uniformity only if all 1<=L<=X^(1/4) blocks are proved with the actual profiles.
